items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1964-04-25
items.q: When I found out he was a colored boy, I stopped hiring him.

ctx.x: Yeah. When I found out he was a colored boy, I stopped hiring him. I never knew he was colored, but he married a white woman. He's married to a white lady. And I never knew it. But I didn't know that he was a colored boy. Never knew it. One fine day, I passed on Osterlein Street, where he lived. And I saw his daddy. And that was a no.
What did he play? What instrument? Ask him what instrument.
